applies_why: The judge text evaluates a collision over Isaiah 7:14 between the CR2 chain and DR3's pressed chain, so it governs the chain-against-chain weighing the rule requires.
quote: the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: 'never verse by verse' and 'that no one of them states the contrary in its own words ... retires': I weighed (1) treating Isaiah 7:14's silence on the mechanism as decisive, against (2) weighing CR2's and DR3's chains by footing.
why: The judge resolves the Isaiah 7:14 link by saying the sign itself is silent on mechanism rather than weighing the CR2 and DR3 chains by footing, so it applies a verse-by-verse or stating-verse test that K-C retires.
